clean_environment: Fresh Ubuntu container from the public base image; fresh official Lean 4.35.0 install.
dependencies: Fresh pinned public checkouts and public Mathlib cache; no previous project build or proof-writable dependency cache reused.
order: Comparator first; later full build and audits sandboxed. The later build may reuse project outputs generated by comparator in this same fresh run.
outer_container: 2 CPUs, 7 GiB memory; capability bounding set and outer AppArmor/seccomp/systempath restrictions relaxed to permit nested bubblewrap; trusted bwrap uses its setuid helper mode.
proof_sandbox: Native Lake bubblewrap enabled; later steps use the checked run_sandboxed.sh wrapper. Parent-owned evidence is outside writable .lake.
scope: The comparator target is Erdos271.main_result only. The exact-name/axiom audit covers all 27 designated declarations.
bootstrap_scope: Stock Lean binary release and cached Mathlib dependencies; no independent source rebuild of Lean or Mathlib.
